contentCare.pauseTitle: Would you like to read that once more?
contentCare.pausePrompt: You are in a professional space. This wording could come across as a personal attack. Would you like to edit it or send it as it is?
contentCare.reviewTitle: This text may need a review
contentCare.reviewPrompt: This wording may be a threat or a call for violence. You can edit it or submit it to a moderator. It will be published only after approval.
contentCare.suggestion: Consider describing what happened, how it affected you and what you would like to change. You can be angry, critical and disagree.
contentCare.limits: The check recognizes some Swedish and English phrases. It can misread context and miss other harmful content. A moderator considers the content, not just individual words.
contentCare.guideLink: Tips for clear and respectful conversations
contentCare.held: Your content is hidden and awaiting moderator approval. You can provide context under My reviews.
contentCare.guideIntro: Nolto welcomes disagreement, difficult discussions and criticism. These suggestions can help you make your point without attacking the person you are speaking to.
contentCare.observeTitle: Describe what you saw or heard
contentCare.observeText: Start with a specific event. “The meeting was moved with an hour’s notice” is easier to discuss than “You never respect my time”.
contentCare.feelText: You might feel frustrated, worried or disappointed. Avoid declaring what the other person thinks or intends.
contentCare.needText: You may need preparation time, clarity, fairness or a chance to be heard.
contentCare.requestText: Suggest something the other person can respond to. Listen to their needs too, and be open to another proposal.
contentCare.example: “When the meeting was moved that morning, I felt frustrated because I need to plan my work. Could we agree changes by the day before next time?”
contentCare.howItWorks: How writing prompts and review work
contentCare.process: Some personal attacks trigger a reminder that you can choose to proceed past. Some direct threats and calls for violence instead keep the content hidden until a moderator reviews it. This also applies to edits, replies and published articles. You can provide context and request reconsideration under My reviews. Reporting remains available for anything the check misses. Images and all languages cannot be assessed automatically.
contentCare.privacy: The text check runs on Nolto’s backend. The check itself does not save your draft or send it to an external AI service. Private messages are not checked. Content submitted for review is stored privately along with explanations and decisions. If you request deletion, it is hidden immediately and deleted after 30 days under our privacy policy.
contentCare.sourceNote: This guide is inspired by Nonviolent Communication. Nolto is not affiliated with or certified by CNVC. Learn more at
contentCare.queueIntro: Read the full context. A language-rule match is not a verdict. Explain the decision to the author and distinguish attacks from quotations, criticism and reporting of abuse.
contentCare.ownQueueIntro: This contains posts hidden from others while under review and content that has not been approved. You can provide context once per version or request deletion.
contentCare.queueEmpty: There is no content waiting here right now.
contentCare.queueFailed: The review queue could not be loaded.
contentCare.reviewReason: An automatic language rule flagged a possible threat or call for violence. This content is not public while under review.
contentCare.historyFailed: Previous explanations could not be loaded. Reload before making a decision.
contentCare.action_appeal: Author’s context or request for reconsideration
contentCare.contextLabel: What would you like the moderator to know?
contentCare.noSelfReview: Another moderator needs to review your content.
contentCare.decisionFailed: The decision could not be saved. The content may have changed or already been reviewed. Read the updated version and try again.
contentCare.deleteHint: Content is permanently deleted after 30 days.
contentCare.deletionRequested: Deletion requested. The content is hidden and will be deleted after 30 days.
contentCare.deletionFailed: Deletion could not be requested. Please try again.
